text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: One day in the cafeteria, Air Messiah and Line Craft were enjoying a casual chat—

text_block_list.name: Line Craft
text_block_list.text: —Come to think of it, I heard, Messiah-san! You've been keeping a crab lately?

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: Yes. Dealing with a living creature naturally comes with plenty of challenges... but more than that, it is truly adorable.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: For all the effort put in, you gain just as much joy and learning. I've even made acquaintances who also keep crabs, so it has been a wonderful experience.

text_block_list.name: Line Craft
text_block_list.text: Waaah, you really are amazing, Messiah-san! Being able to look at it that way is so wonderful!

text_block_list.name: Line Craft
text_block_list.text: Listening to you talk about it, I feel like I'm getting interested in crabs too, somehow♪

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: Truly? Actually keeping one is quite lovely, you know.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: Crabs are omnivorous and will eat anything. Therefore, I provide both animal-based and plant-based food.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: Yet, even after preparing high-quality food with great care, there are times when it will only take a single bite.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: Having personal likes and dislikes, isn't that almost human-like? I find even that part of it endearing.

text_block_list.name: Mature Messiah?
text_block_list.text: What should we do for dinner tonight? Considering our breakfast and lunch menus, the nutrients we are lacking would be—

text_block_list.name: Mature Messiah?
text_block_list.text: —Indeed. Shall we go shopping together and decide?

text_block_list.name: Line Craft
text_block_list.text: ...Huh?

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: As long as you keep a pet, dirt is unavoidable. Frequent cleaning is an absolute must, and it can be quite a chore.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: Yet, it is also in those moments that I truly feel that it is alive, that it is here beside me.

text_block_list.name: Mature Messiah?
text_block_list.text: Thank you for cleaning the bath. Well then, I'll take out the trash—eh, you already took it out?

text_block_list.name: Mature Messiah?
text_block_list.text: Oh my, I can't let myself be outdone. Since this is our home, we must keep it clean together.

text_block_list.name: Line Craft
text_block_list.text: Wait, huh?

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: Furthermore, as the crab grows, I adjust the moss terrarium as well.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: After all, its living space must be improved to match its growth.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: Though having said that, I sometimes end up adding unnecessary cute little trinkets too...

text_block_list.name: Mature Messiah?
text_block_list.text: Living here over time, our belongings have really accumulated and it's getting a bit cramped, isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Mature Messiah?
text_block_list.text: Next time we move, shall we look into getting a larger apartment?

text_block_list.name: Mature Messiah?
text_block_list.text: Not just because of our things, but even though it's just the two of us now, perhaps someday—

text_block_list.name: Line Craft
text_block_list.text: (...Wh-What was that just now? We were talking about crabs, right?)

text_block_list.name: Line Craft
text_block_list.text: (So why am I... wh-why is my heart pounding like this?!)

text_block_list.name: Line Craft
text_block_list.text: (Is this thanks to keeping a crab too, I wonder...)

text_block_list.name: Line Craft
text_block_list.text: A-Anyway, receiving so much love from you, Messiah-san, it must be super happy!

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Affection...
...Yes, everything is for that little one's sake.

text_block_list.name: Line Craft
text_block_list.text: Messiah-san? Is something wrong?

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: Ah, no... Indeed, I simply wish for it to be happy. Which is why—

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: I gave the crab away.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: As I continued adapting the environment for the crab's needs, keeping it in the dorms reached its limit.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: So before things got worse, I entrusted it to a trustworthy crab keeper.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: It is regrettable that I could not care for it until the very end, but considering what would bring it the most happiness, I decided this was best.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: It was a decision very typical of the deeply responsible Air Messiah, and there was no mistake in it. But still—

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: Ah...

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: ...Yes, it is rather lonely.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: I quietly wished that this experience would one day lead to happiness with someone precious she would meet in the future.
